fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on Miami and Miami Beach social life, including nightlife and entertainment venues, public disorder associated with dance/supper club crowds, and civic concerns. Contains letters to the editor, discussion of landlord-tenant law and police response in Miami Beach, and commentary on local politics and the sheriff’s race. Also features a serialized fiction piece (“Love in a Lumber Camp” by John Kimble), notes on aviation and radio communications linked to Lindbergh-era flights, and extensive hotel, tourism, and business advertising.
